title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

Salary: £29,000k
Location: Leicester - free parking
Hours: Full-time, Monday-Friday 8.30 - 4.30pm

About the Role

An excellent opportunity has arisen for an Accounts Assistant to join an established business based in Leicester. Working as part of a supportive finance team, you will be responsible for assisting with a variety of accounting and administrative duties to ensure the smooth running of the department.

This role would suit an organised individual with strong attention to detail, good communication skills, and previous experience within a finance function.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing and reconciling financial transactions.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and documentation.
- Assisting with payment processing and account administration.
- Preparing journals and supporting finance reports.
- Completing regular account reconciliations.
- Responding to internal and external finance queries.
- Supporting month-end and year-end processes.
- Providing assistance across the wider finance team as required.
- Undertaking general administrative duties associated with the role.

Skills & Experience
- Previous experience in an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant or similar role.
- Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Ability to manage workload effectively and meet deadlines.
- Good communication and interpersonal skills.
- Positive and proactive attitude with a team-focused approach.

What's on Offer
- Competitive salary package.
- Free onsite parking.
- Friendly and supportive working environment.
- Training and development opportunities.
- Long-term career prospects.

title: Accounts Assistant / AP
description:
Exclusive Accounts Assistant / Accounts Payable

Location: Ibstock, Leicestershire
Salary: up to £32,000 (DOE)
Job Type: Permanent, Full Time
Working Pattern: Office Based
Hours: Full time, flexible
Holidays: 22 days + bank holidays
Benefits: Free on-site parking, progression opportunities

The Opportunity

SF Recruitment are currently working with a growing and ambitious business in Leicestershire who are looking to recruit an Accounts Assistant / Accounts Payable Assistant to join their finance team due to a recent progression in their team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with previous accounts payable experience who is looking to join a fast-paced environment. The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting the day-to-day finance function, ensuring supplier invoices are processed accurately and payments are made on time.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing high volumes of purchase invoices accurately and efficiently.
- Matching, batching and coding invoices against purchase orders.
- Reconciling supplier statements and investigating discrepancies.
- Preparing and processing supplier payment runs.
- Managing supplier queries and maintaining strong working relationships.
- Monitoring the accounts payable inbox and ensuring queries are resolved promptly.
- Assisting with bank reconciliations and general finance administration.
- Supporting month-end processes, including accruals and reconciliations.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring invoices are authorised appropriately.
- Assisting the wider finance team with ad hoc duties when required, including month - end duties.

About You
- Previous experience working within an Accounts Payable or Accounts Assistant position.
- Confident processing purchase invoices and reconciling supplier statements.
- Strong attention to detail with excellent organisational skills.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
- Good Excel skills and experience using accounting software.
- Strong communication skills with the ability to build relationships internally and externally.
- A proactive, hands-on approach and willingness to support the wider finance team.

title: Finance Assistant
company: Optima UK Inc Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Finance Assistant

Location: Leicester, LE4
Hours: Part-time - approximately 20 hours per week (to be confirmed)
Working Arrangement: Fully office-based

The Role

Optima UK is recruiting on behalf of an established manufacturing business in Leicester that is looking for an experienced Finance Assistant to join its team on a part-time basis.

This is a varied, hands-on position covering credit control, purchase ledger, account reconciliations and payroll support. Credit control will be a key focus, making this an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys taking ownership of their workload and working as part of a supportive finance team.

The ideal candidate will have previous transactional finance experience, a proactive approach and the confidence to manage customer accounts and outstanding payments. Experience with Sage Line 50 or within a manufacturing environment would be an advantage.

Key Responsibilities
- Credit Control: Manage approximately 60 customer accounts with a combined ledger value of around £1 million, chasing overdue payments, monitoring outstanding balances and maintaining positive customer relationships.
- Payroll Support: Assist with monthly payroll processing for approximately 100 hourly-paid and 30 salaried employees, with payments made on the last Friday of each month.
- Purchase Ledger: Process supplier invoices, including matching, batching and coding, and assist with two supplier payment runs per month.
- Account Reconciliations: Complete bank, credit card and other account reconciliations, identifying and resolving discrepancies.
- General Finance Administration: Maintain accurate financial records, process transactions and ensure deadlines are met.
- Team Support: Work closely with colleagues across the finance function, assisting with additional duties when required.

Skills & Experience Required
- Previous experience as a Finance Assistant, Accounts Assistant or within a similar transactional finance role.
- Practical credit control experience, including managing customer accounts and chasing outstanding payments.
- Good understanding of purchase ledger, invoice processing and account reconciliations.
- Strong numerical accuracy, attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Confident communication skills, particularly when dealing with customers regarding outstanding payments.
- Ability to manage workloads independently while contributing to a wider team.

Desirable Experience
- Experience supporting payroll processing.
- Knowledge of Sage Line 50.
- AAT qualification or equivalent.
- Previous experience working within a manufacturing environment.

About You

We are looking for someone who is positive, reliable and willing to get involved. You will be comfortable taking responsibility for your own workload, supporting colleagues when needed and going the extra mile to ensure the finance function runs smoothly.

Apply Now

If you are an experienced Finance Assistant looking for a varied, part-time opportunity within a Leicester-based manufacturing business, we would like to hear from you.

Apply today with your up-to-date CV, and a member of the Optima UK recruitment team will be in touch.

title: Senior Marketing Executive
company: Macildowie Recruitment and Retention - Agency - Permanent
description:
Senior Marketing Executive
Barwell, office based
09:00 - 17:00, Monday to Friday

Are you a creative, hands-on marketer who loves variety, enjoys bringing products to life and isn't afraid to roll up your sleeves?

We're working with an established, product-led business in Leicester that's looking for a talented Senior Marketing Executive to join its team. This is a fantastic opportunity for a marketing generalist who enjoys getting involved in everything from campaign planning and graphic design to product marketing, website development and digital activity.

You'll be joining a business with a recognisable brand, a diverse product portfolio and an established team around you. They're looking for somebody who can bring fresh ideas, take ownership and help drive marketing activity forward.

The Role

No two days will look quite the same! You'll be responsible for delivering a broad range of marketing activity, combining creativity with commercial thinking.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Planning, coordinating and delivering marketing campaigns across multiple channels.
- Creating engaging marketing materials using Adobe InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop.
- Supporting product launches, promotions and wider product marketing initiatives.
- Developing and maintaining website content through Shopify, including SEO optimisation.
- Working alongside the ecommerce team to support product visibility across Shopify, Amazon, eBay and other online marketplaces.
- Producing creative assets, brochures, product literature and promotional materials.
- Monitoring campaign performance and using insights to improve future marketing activity.
- Supporting wider brand development and marketing projects across the business.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for somebody who has a strong foundation in marketing, enjoys being hands-on and can confidently manage a varied workload.

To be successful, you'll need:
- Proven experience in a broad marketing role, ideally within a product-led business.
- Strong graphic design skills using Adobe InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop.
- Experience developing and delivering marketing plans and campaigns.
- A good understanding of product marketing and how to communicate product benefits effectively.
- Hands-on experience with Shopify website development and SEO.
- An understanding of selling through ecommerce platforms, including Amazon, eBay and Shopify.
- Excellent organisational skills, attention to detail and an analytical approach.

It Would Be Great If You Also Have:
- Experience working in a B2 B marketing environment.
- Previous people management or supervisory experience.
- Social media management experience.
- Experience delivering email marketing campaigns.

Interested?

If you're a creative marketing generalist who loves variety, has strong Adobe skills and enjoys seeing the commercial impact of your work, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Administration Assistant
description: Job Overview Do you want to make a difference to the families, young people and children living in Leicester, Leicestershire, and Rutland? You're not just admin, are you? Our team of administrators provide support for over two hundred clinical staff who deliver services to children aged 0-19 years across Leicester, Leicestershire, and Rutland. You will need to be able to demonstrate experience of working with confidential and sensitive information and can work using your own initiative as well as working as part of a team.
